_notes: Agent B. All balancing lives here (master prompt 4.6-4.8). Sell price = baseValue x weightFactor x sizeClass.mult x variant.valueMult x market x (1 + shop sellBonus), rounded, min 1. t = (weight - min) / (max - min) of the fish's weight range.

start._island: Day one is tiny (4.6): the sandbar, a crooked pier stub (part of the sandbar, one fishing spot), the tarp lean-to camp_l0 with a wicker basket, the shop_l1 crate stall and the rowboat.

weightRoll._notes: Suggested roll for Agent A (rules.js rollWeight): t = random() ^ skew; a perfect cast uses perfectSkew (heavier fish more likely).

pearls._notes: Earned only, never sold. Per catch by tier, plus a trophy bonus, plus the variant's pearls (variants.json).

variantSets._notes: Logbook goals per species. Reward coins = the fish's baseValue x coinsPerBase (x100 in test mode), paid once when the set is complete.

saturation._notes: Each fish of one species sold adds 1. Past freeUnits, every unit drops that species' price by dropPerUnit, down to floor. Recovers recoverPerMinute units per minute, also while away.

workers._notes: A fisher needs a bunk (workers' hut) and a spot to fish from (the sandbar stub, every pier, and plots with crewSpots). Each lands one fish every catchSeconds from the home island's common and uncommon pool (by spawnWeight), sold on the spot for the pool's average baseValue x valueMult x hut rateMult x (1 + smokehouse crewBonus).

nets._notes: Crab pots and nets on owned land plots fill over time.

sandbar.name: The Sandbar
sandbar.about: Barely bigger than your boat. A pier stub, a tarp, a fire.

palm_spit.name: Palm Spit
palm_spit.about: A crooked spit of sand with three leaning palms. Room for a crew to sleep.

tidepool_shelf.name: Tide-pool Shelf
tidepool_shelf.about: Flat rock full of pools at low tide. Crabs, anemones, and a place for an aquarium.

wreck_beach.name: Wreck Beach
wreck_beach.about: Where the red boat beached itself years ago. Good timber, good shelter, room for a dock.

sunset_dunes.name: Sunset Dunes
sunset_dunes.about: A long golden beach east of the spit, palms on the crest. Room for a whole works.

kelp_shallows.name: Kelp Shallows
kelp_shallows.about: Shallow water thick with kelp. The wraiths like it here.

basalt_cliff.name: Basalt Cliff
basalt_cliff.about: Black columns rising out of the surf. One day a lighthouse will stand here.

gull_headland.name: Gull Headland
gull_headland.about: A grassy rock shoulder past the west cliffs, cairns up the knoll, nets in the wind.

mooring_deep.name: The Old Mooring's Deep
mooring_deep.about: The dark water where the Old Mooring has lived for fifty years.

lantern_atoll.name: Lantern Atoll
lantern_atoll.about: A ring of palms far out in deep water. Its lanterns light the way home.

piers._notes: Bought in order. Each needs its plot, reaches deeper water (depth in metres, for Agent A) and gives the crew one more spot to fish from.

pier_1.name: Plank Walk
pier_1.about: Six planks past the stub. Just deep enough for the flounder.

pier_2.name: Palm Pier
pier_2.about: Lashed to the palms and out over the sand drop.

pier_3.name: Long Pier
pier_3.about: Long enough to reach the kelp line.

pier_4.name: Wreck Pier
pier_4.about: Built on the red boat's ribs. Deep water on both sides.

pier_5.name: Kelp Pier
pier_5.about: Floats on barrels above the kelp forest.

pier_6.name: Mooring Pier
pier_6.about: Ends right above the Old Mooring's hole.

buildings._notes: Level 0 = not built. Each level has its own model <building>_l<n>. A building needs its site plot before level 1.

shop.name: Shop
shop.about: Sells your catch. A better shop draws better buyers.

levels.name: Crate Stall
levels.about: A crate stall under a patched sail.

levels.name: Upturned Hull
levels.about: An old hull flipped over and turned into a proper shop.

levels.name: Crow's Nest Hull
levels.about: Two storeys of hull, with a crow's nest to spot buyers from afar.

cooler.name: Cooler
cooler.about: Holds the fish you keep until you sell them.

levels.name: Wicker Basket
levels.about: Lives under the tarp. Smells of yesterday.

levels.name: Salt Barrel
levels.about: A barrel of coarse salt. Keeps fish for days.

levels.name: Ice Chest
levels.about: Lined with cork, packed with ice from who knows where.

levels.name: Ice House
levels.about: Stone walls, sawdust and ice blocks. Nothing spoils here.

workers_hut.name: Workers' hut
workers_hut.about: Bunks for your crew. A bigger hut fits more fishers, and they work faster.

levels.name: Net Loft
levels.about: Hammocks strung between the palms, under a net roof.

levels.name: Bunkhouse
levels.about: Proper walls, four bunks and a stove.

levels.name: Crew Hall
levels.about: A long hall with a table for the whole crew.

smokehouse.name: Smokehouse
smokehouse.about: Smokes part of the crew's catch so it sells for more.

levels.name: Smoke Rack
levels.about: Racks over a driftwood fire.

levels.name: Smokehouse
levels.about: A shed built from the wreck's planks, smoking day and night.

levels.name: Cure House
levels.about: Barrels of brine, hanging fish and a proper chimney.

aquarium.name: Aquarium
aquarium.about: Visitors pay to see every species in your logbook.

levels.name: Tide Tank
levels.about: A walled-off tide pool with a viewing plank.

levels.name: Glass Gallery
levels.about: Salvaged portholes set into rock tanks.

levels.name: Aquarium Hall
levels.about: A great glass hall. The rare fish glow after dark.

boat_dock.name: Boat dock
boat_dock.about: Where your boat ties up. A bigger dock can fit a bigger boat.

levels.name: Plank Jetty
levels.about: A jetty on the wreck's keel. Room for a skiff.

levels.name: Boat Dock
levels.about: A real dock with a crane for a sloop.

levels.name: Shipwright's Slip
levels.about: A slipway and a shipwright who never sleeps.

net_rig.name: Net Rig
net_rig.about: Nets that fish on their own, day and night.

levels.name: Stake Net
levels.about: A hand-knotted net on driftwood stakes, cork floats bobbing.

levels.name: Tidal Weir
levels.about: A woven fence that lets the tide in and the fish not out.

levels.name: Drift-net Raft
levels.about: A moored raft with a big hand-cranked winch.

reel_mill.name: Reel Mill
reel_mill.about: A machine that casts, waits and strikes for you.

levels.name: Bell Rack
levels.about: A row of rods; a bell rings on a bite and a bucket weight strikes.

levels.name: Tide Wheel
levels.about: A waterwheel on the tide turns a long shaft of reels.

levels.name: Clockwork Reel Mill
levels.about: A brass gear tower working a dozen lines at once.

cannery.name: Cannery
cannery.about: Turns the harbour's catch into tins. Everything idle earns more.

levels.name: Tin Bench
levels.about: Tins, brine and a hand press under a sailcloth roof.

levels.name: Steam Cannery
levels.about: The wreck's old boiler, hissing away in a plank shed.

levels.name: Cannery Works
levels.about: A chimney, a conveyor chute to the pier and a whistle at noon.

boats._notes: Bought in order. tier must fit the dock (boat_dock maxBoat). reach = the farthest island index the boat can sail to.

rowboat.name: Rowboat
rowboat.about: It leaks, but only a little.

patched_skiff.name: Patched Skiff
patched_skiff.about: More patch than skiff. Gets you to the reef and back.

sail_sloop.name: Sail Sloop
sail_sloop.about: A real sail. The fjord and the caldera are in reach.

storm_cutter.name: Storm Cutter
storm_cutter.about: Built to sail straight through lightning.

wear._notes: 4.7b. Rod strain per fight = max(0, fish kg - rating x strainFrom) x strainPerKg; it breaks at the rod's durability (the starter never breaks). Line wear per fight = line.wear x (fish kg / line strength, 0.2..2), doubled on a snap; a worn line keeps half its strength at full wear. Repair = repairShare x the rod's price. On a snap the hook, sinker, float and leader are lost (the tackle box keeps each with tackleBoxSave), and one lure.

offline._notes: Crew, nets and aquarium keep earning while the game is closed, up to capHours. The night watch raises the cap.

watch.name: Lamp on the pier
watch.about: Someone leaves a lamp lit so the crew keeps going.

watch.name: Night watchman
watch.about: Old Tobin's cousin keeps the crew awake.

watch.name: Lighthouse keeper
watch.about: The lighthouse keeps an eye on everything.

watch.name: Harbour bell
watch.about: Rings every hour, all night long.
